In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, on the average, the resonance σ constants of tetrazol-5-yl groups lie between the σ constants of phenyl and 2-thienyl groups.
the σR constants of the tetrazole group are in the range 0.3-0.4, which is comparable with the values of the resonance σR-constants for the pyridyl group.
the tetrazol-5-yl group is a stronger electron-withdrawing group in comparison with the nitro group, but weaker in comparison with the cyano group.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the resonance σR-constants in the series of tetrazole containing vinyl monomers can be estimated with the use of the 13C chemical shifts of the vinyl carbons and the σR constants for the phenyl group.
the σR-constant of the tetrazole ring in the tetrazole-containing monomers is 0.4.
the σR constant of the tetrazole group is equal to -0.1.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the resonance σR constant of the tetrazole-1-yl group is equal to 0.2 and that of the tetrazolate-1-yl anion to 0.4, while the σR constants of tetrazole-2-yl, tetrazole-3-yl, and tetrazole-5-yl are equal to −0.1, −0.2, and −0.4, respectively.
the tetrazol-5-yl group can be regarded as a weak electron-donor substituent, which is comparable to the methoxy group.
the σR constants of tetrazole and its 1,5-disubstituted derivatives can be calculated from the chemical shifts of the C(1)-carbon atoms in their vinyl derivatives.
